# email-campaigns-claude (vendored)

The `email-campaigns/SKILL.md` playbook under this directory is vendored from
**[irinabuht12-oss/email-campaigns-claude](https://github.com/irinabuht12-oss/email-campaigns-claude)**
(by Ira). It is an unmodified copy of the upstream file.

- **Source:** https://github.com/irinabuht12-oss/email-campaigns-claude
- **License:** MIT (see `LICENSE` in this directory) — attribution preserved per the license.
- **What we use it for:** the Marketing & Sales phase loads it when drafting the launch
  email to the Phase 4 waitlist (HTML email patterns, design blocks, pre-send checklist).
  Actual sending via Resend is NOT wired — the pipeline generates the email; sending is a
  human step (or a future optional Resend connector).

Loaded by the same `lib/frameworks/` loader as the other vendor sources.
